description: I am building a team who can build and secure future
summary:
My project is called Mars Survival Map - Safe Guide for First Astronauts. I made this project solo for the challenge Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map.

Mars is a dangerous planet for astronauts. There is no air to breathe, no food, very cold weather, and big dust storms. My project solves this problem by making a simple and colorful survival map for the first astronauts who will go to Mars.

My map has 5 important layers: 1. Safe Landing Zone where the rocket can land safely, 2. Water Zone where astronauts can find ice and water, 3. Home Zone where they can build a shelter, 4. Danger Zone where dust storms come, and 5. Food Zone where they can grow plants in a greenhouse.

This map is important because it will help astronauts stay safe, find water and food quickly, and know where not to go. With my map, going to Mars becomes easier and safer for everyone.
details: My project is a colorful Mars Survival Map. It works like Google Maps, but for Mars. How it works: Astronauts open the map before landing. They see 5 colors. Green is Safe Landing, Blue is Water, Yellow is Home, Red is Danger Dust Storm, and Dark Green is Food. They follow the map to land safely, find water, build a home, and avoid danger. Benefit: It saves time and saves lives. Astronauts will not get lost on Mars. Tools used: I used Canva on my mobile to design the map and presentation. I did not use coding. I used NASA information about Mars to choose the zones. My project is creative because it is simple, easy for kids and astronauts to understand, and it uses colors and pictures instead of difficult words.
